about: Experience Secret Agent Clank™ originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

When a valuable gem is stolen and Ratchet is charged with its theft, only one Robot can save him - Secret Agent Clank! It's up to the galaxy's top spy to solve this mystery and uncover the true mastermind behind the crime.
•Unleash the deadliest weapons in the galaxy and master the martial art of Clank-Fu
•Play Clank, Ratchet, and Captain Qwark in this undercover adventure

This title has been converted from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
summary: Experience Secret Agent Clank™ originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
